newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse to shut on Sundays.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse to shut on Sundays.

text.p: The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said on Wednesday it would observe the weekend on Saturday and Sunday and work on Friday after the government switched its weekly holiday to Sunday from Friday.
Trading hours will be from 9:45 a.m. (0445 GMT) to 2:00 p.m. from Monday to Thursday and from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. on Friday, a KSE statement said.
"The clearing day will be Tuesday instead of Monday for the transactions taking place from Wednesday to Tuesday," it said. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
